summary: Tungray Technologies Inc filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders to be held on June 30, 2026. The agenda includes election of five directors and ratification of Guangdong Prouden CPAs GP as independent auditor for fiscal 2026. No transaction, price, or strategic event is discussed. The filing is a routine meeting reminder and proxy solicitation, not a special situation.
